column7: NotificationChannel.URL (a webhook bearer credential) was stored with no at-rest encryption. It is now encrypted with an AAD bound to the channel id (URLEnc/URLMeta), migrated at startup (MigrateNotificationChannelURLsToEncrypted) and swept on DEK rotation; this test proves the stored value is bound ciphertext (a ciphertext copied between rows is refused). Same area as notification-channel-url-at-rest-format-001 (#2468). Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
